description: Wrap the input space in its convex hull (smallest enclosing convex polygon).
instructions:
Wraps the input Space in its convex hull — the smallest convex polygon containing every vertex → one output Space. No parameters.

TIP: use it to regularise a jagged or concave outline before massing / area take-off, or to get a clean envelope around a cluster of points or rooms. Wire a Space into the input handle.
